summary: First E2E test of the new Vendor PWA (Vite + React) replacing the deprecated Expo app. Backend API tests 10/10 passed (auth, orders list, products CRUD, profile update, status toggle). Frontend E2E on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): login (valid + invalid OTP error), dashboard stat cards + shop-closed alert + quick actions, orders page filters + empty state + refresh, products full CRUD (add/search/toggle-stock/edit/delete with confirm), profile shop toggle Open<->Closed + profile save, sidebar navigation, mobile hamburger menu + sidebar overlay, logout, protected-route redirect, and zustand-persist auth persistence on reload. One critical CSS bug found and fixed: on desktop viewport, the sidebar was translated offscreen (x=-260) because `.sidebar-hidden { transform: translateX(-100%) }` overrode the intended `lg:translate-x-0` Tailwind utility, leaving desktop users with no way to click nav-* links (fell back to URL navigation until fix). Applied minimal CSS override to force translate(0) at min-width:1024px and re-verified all sidebar nav clicks work.

Fixed in this iteration by adding a min-width:1024px media query in /app/vendor-pwa/src/index.css to force transform: translateX(0) !important on .sidebar and .sidebar.sidebar-hidden.

rca_of_the_issue: Sidebar hidden on desktop: JSX applied class `sidebar sidebar-hidden lg:translate-x-0` when sidebar closed. `.sidebar-hidden { transform: translateX(-100%) }` in index.css directly sets the `transform` property. Tailwind v4's `.lg\:translate-x-0` utility only updates the `--tw-translate-x` custom property (used via `transform: translate(var(--tw-translate-x), var(--tw-translate-y))`). Because `.sidebar-hidden`'s direct `transform` assignment appeared later in the cascade (or with equal specificity), it won over the utility, keeping the sidebar at x=-260 on all viewports. Reproduction: login, set viewport 1920x1080, inspect aside.sidebar getBoundingClientRect -> x=-260. Mitigation applied: added `@media (min-width:1024px) { .sidebar, .sidebar.sidebar-hidden { transform: translateX(0) !important; } }` in /app/vendor-pwa/src/index.css. Verified: post-fix aside.sidebar x=0 and all nav-* clicks navigate.
